title: Happily Ever After
cn: 第 6 集 · 从此幸福快乐
novel:
Ted tried to [[pretend|pretend]] everything was fine. He told the gang he was [[relieved|relieved]] that Stella left him. "I [[dodged|dodge]] a bullet," he said with a forced smile.

But the gang knew better. Marshall [[encouraged|encourage]] him to face his feelings. "You can't just [[bottle|bottle]] everything up," he said.

Meanwhile, each member of the gang [[avoided|avoid]] their own [[awkward|awkward]] [[encounter|encounter]]. Marshall ran into an old [[bully|bully]] from school. Lily met a [[creepy|creepy]] guy who would not leave her alone. Robin faced a [[humiliating|humiliating]] moment on live TV.

Barney, of all people, hid from a woman he had [[wronged|wrong]]. He spotted her in a restaurant and ducked under the table. "She's going to [[destroy|destroy]] me," he [[whispered|whisper]].

Ted finally [[bumped|bump]] into Stella and Tony at a restaurant. He felt a [[surge|surge]] of anger, but he [[swallowed|swallow]] it. "I hope you're happy," he said [[coldly|coldly]].

Stella looked [[guilty|guilty]]. "Ted, I'm sorry—"

"Don't," Ted [[interrupted|interrupt]]. He walked away, his head held high.

Later, Robin found Ted on the rooftop. "You didn't [[bottle|bottle]] it up," she said. "You faced it."

Ted nodded. "It hurt. But I'll be okay."

Sometimes, the [[bravest|brave]] thing was simply to keep walking forward.

pretend.en: to act as if something is true when it is not

relieved.en: feeling happy that something bad did not happen

dodge.en: to move quickly to avoid something

encourage.en: to give someone confidence to do something

avoid.en: to stay away from someone or something

encounter.en: a meeting, especially one that is unexpected

bully.en: someone who hurts or frightens others

creepy.en: making you feel nervous and slightly frightened

humiliating.en: making you feel ashamed in front of others

guilty.en: feeling bad about something you did

brave.en: showing no fear in a difficult situation
